ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: The following figure is a flood frequency curve calculated by a watershed management unit from long-term hydrological data (1875—1975). If calculated using hydrological data from more recent years (1945—1975), the flood frequency shows an increase. Please answer the following questions accordingly. <image1> On the flood frequency curve for 1945—1975, by approximately how many years is the recurrence interval of the water level at which disasters begin shortened compared with the flood frequency curve for 1875—1975?

matched_variant_raw.rewritten_question_text:
The following figure is a flood frequency curve calculated by a watershed management unit from long-term hydrological data (1875—1975). If calculated using hydrological data from more recent years (1945—1975), the flood frequency shows an increase. Please answer the following questions accordingly.

<image1>

On the flood frequency curve for 1945—1975, by approximately how many years is the recurrence interval of the water level at which disasters begin shortened compared with the flood frequency curve for 1875—1975?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a flood frequency curve graph, with the horizontal axis as recurrence interval and the vertical axis as water level. There are two curves in the figure, respectively representing flood frequencies calculated from 1945—1975 and 1875—1975 data; there is also a horizontal dashed line indicating "the water level at which disasters begin". Then reason: Looking along the horizontal dashed line of "the water level at which disasters begin", the intersection with the 1945—1975 curve reads down to the horizontal axis at about 2 years; the intersection with the 1875—1975 curve reads down to the horizontal axis at about 5 years. The shortening of the recurrence interval is approximately 5 years−2 years=3 years.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中有两条洪水频率曲线，横轴为再现周期，纵轴为水位，并有一条表示“开始出现灾害的水位”的水平虚线。沿这条水平虚线分别找到与1945—1975曲线、1875—1975曲线的交点，再向下读横轴数值：1945—1975约为2年，1875—1975约为5年。计算缩短时间：5年−2年≈3年。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the straightforward graph-reading route: use the given disaster-threshold line, read the two return periods directly, then subtract. It relies primarily on visual intersections rather than additional calculation beyond difference.
planner_metadata.image_role: Inspect the flood-frequency graph: identify the horizontal dashed line labeled “开始出现灾害的水位”; note where it intersects the 1945—1975 curve and the 1875—1975 curve; project those intersection points down to the x-axis labeled “再现周期(年)”. The readings are about 2 years for 1945—1975 and about 5 years for 1875—1975.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text to know the comparison required: at the water level where disasters begin, compare the 1945—1975 curve against the 1875—1975 curve and find how many years the recurrence period is shortened.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: A flood frequency curve gives, for a fixed water level, the corresponding recurrence/return period on the x-axis. “缩短的时间” means subtract the newer-period return period from the older-period return period.

开始出现灾害的水位，在1945—1975年的洪水频率曲线上，其再现周期较1875—1975年的洪水频率曲线缩短的时间约为多少年？
